sans.purpose: Primary typeface for all UI text. Clear, professional, warm.

mono.purpose: Financial amounts, codes, and data where alignment matters.

serif.purpose: Optional display face for editorial content. Currently unused in active UI.

shadows.name: resting-card
shadows.purpose: Subtle depth on cards at rest. Barely perceptible lift.

shadows.name: hover-card
shadows.purpose: Slightly stronger shadow on interactive hover. Signals tappability.

shadows.name: fab
shadows.purpose: Elevated shadow for the floating action button. Distinct from cards.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: Shadow for floating menus and popovers.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Drawers use overlay blur, not shadow, for depth.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, color changes).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrance animations (drawer slide, fade in, count-up).

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: hover state, focus ring appearance.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Standard transitions: color changes, opacity shifts.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Drawer slide-in, progress bar fill, count-up animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main CTA. Used for form submissions, primary actions, and the FAB.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; height: 2.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--primary-foreground); background: var(--primary); border: none; border-radius: calc(0.375rem - 2px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.52 0.18 260); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6231 0.1880 259.8145 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions that need visual presence without dominance.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; height: 2.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--secondary-foreground); background: var(--secondary); border: none; border-radius: calc(0.375rem - 2px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.9670 0.0029 264.5419 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6231 0.1880 259.8145 / 0.3); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Icon buttons, menu triggers, and inline actions. Appears only on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="8" cy="3" r="1"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1"/><circle cx="8" cy="13" r="1"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; height: 2.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: calc(0.375rem - 2px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6231 0.1880 259.8145 / 0.3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container for budgets, goals, transactions, and data groups.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(0.375rem + 4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.10), 0 1px 2px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.10); transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.10), 0 2px 4px -1px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.10); } .ds-card-header { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 1.5rem; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input for amounts, descriptions, and search fields.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--foreground); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: calc(0.375rem - 2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.05); transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.6231 0.1880 259.8145 / 0.2); } .ds-input:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status labels, tags, and inline indicators. Always pill-shaped.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1rem; color: var(--primary-foreground); background: var(--primary); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-badge-outline { color: var(--foreground); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-badge-destructive { color: white; background: var(--destructive); }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Visual indicator for budget usage, goal progress, and allocation status.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 0.625rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--secondary); } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--primary); border-radius: 9999px; transition: width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-progress-success .ds-progress-fill { background: var(--success); } .ds-progress-danger .ds-progress-fill { background: var(--destructive); } .ds-progress-warning .ds-progress-fill { background: oklch(0.7 0.16 85); }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Mobile primary navigation. Frosted glass bar with centered FAB.
components.html: HomeTrans
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 40; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; height: 4rem; padding: 0 0.25rem; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom); background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.125rem; width: 100%; height: 100%; text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item.active { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--foreground); }

narrative.overview:
Perfin's visual identity is that of a knowledgeable, warm companion helping you navigate your finances. It never lectures or overwhelms. Every screen feels organized without being clinical, professional without being cold. The system prioritizes clarity and comprehension — financial data is presented with gentle authority, making complex information feel approachable and manageable.

The design language balances structure with warmth. Cards are gently curved, spacing is generous but purposeful, and the blue primary color acts as a quiet guide through the interface rather than shouting for attention. Motion is minimal and meaningful — count animations on budget numbers, smooth drawer transitions, subtle hover lifts. The overall impression is of a well-organized desk where everything has its place and nothing is hidden.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, approachable typography with clear hierarchy
Soft color accents that guide without overwhelming
Generous spacing that creates breathing room for financial data
Subtle depth through shadows that appear on interaction, not at rest

rules.name: The Guidance Rule
rules.body: The primary blue is reserved for states that require user action or attention. It highlights what's interactive, not what's informational.

rules.name: The Semantic Integrity Rule
rules.body: Success, destructive, and warning colors never appear as decorative accents. They are reserved exclusively for financial status communication.

rules.name: The Amount Visibility Rule
rules.body: Financial amounts are always rendered in a weight no lighter than 500, often 600-700. The number is the hero of every transaction row, budget card, and balance display.

rules.name: The Interaction Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are earned through interaction, not applied as decoration. A card at rest has a whisper of depth. On hover, the shadow deepens slightly.

rules.name: The Blur Boundary Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is reserved for surfaces that float over content — the bottom navigation bar, popovers, and dropdown menus.

dos: Do use the primary blue sparingly — it guides, it doesn't decorate. One primary CTA per view is usually enough.
Do show financial amounts in bold weight (500-700). The number is always the hero.
Do use semantic colors (success/destructive/warning) exclusively for financial status.
Do maintain consistent 16px internal padding within cards and containers.
Do use shadow-sm at rest and hover:shadow-md for interactive cards.
Do show skeleton loaders while data fetches. Never flash empty states during loading.
Do use dashed borders for invitations ("Set Limit", "Create Account") and solid borders for containers.
donts: Don't use gradient text. Emphasis comes from weight and size, not color tricks.
Don't apply shadows as decoration. Shadows exist to communicate depth and interactivity.
Don't use the primary blue for non-interactive elements.
Don't exceed 1px on borders. Thicker borders compete with content for visual attention.
Don't use modal dialogs for tasks that don't require interruption or protected focus.
Don't show empty states while data is still loading. Guard with undefined checks first.
Don't use emoji as icons. Icons are drawn, from Lucide or custom SVG, in consistent stroke weight.
